treasuryAccount.title: ORIGYN Treasury Account (OTA)

rewardAccount.title: ORIGYN Reward Account (ORA)
rewardAccount.tooltipStake: Token holders are able to stake their OGY and gain rewards by participating in governance.

rewardAccount.tooltipPool: The reward pool consists of 250 million OGY in its first year and will halve every two years to incentivize and reward early and long-term contributors of the ecosystem.
rewardAccount.description: ORIGYN will contribute one billion OGY to an ORIGYN Reward Account (ORA) in benefit of staked and voting holders. The reward pool consists of 250 million OGY in its first year and will halve every two years to incentivize and reward early and long-term contributors of the ecosystem.
